title: 3rd Truth 1st Mystery No Degrees In Essential Power

questions.question: What is the main point of the First Mystery about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Allah’s power has no weakness in it, so nothing is hard for Him to create.

questions.question: Why can weakness never be part of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because His power is tied to His own perfect Being, and weakness is the opposite of power.

questions.question: What example is given to show how different levels can appear in something?
questions.answer: Light can be stronger or weaker when darkness mixes with it.

questions.question: What is another example used to explain degrees in things?
questions.answer: Heat can be more or less depending on coldness.

questions.question: According to the passage, why are there no levels or stages in Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because nothing opposite to His power can enter it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about creating many things compared with creating one thing?
questions.answer: Allah creates many things as easily as one thing.

questions.question: Why can no barrier stop Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because His power has no weakness, shortage, or limitation.

questions.question: How does the passage compare resurrection, spring, a tree, and a flower?
questions.answer: It says all of them are equally easy for Allah to create.

questions.question: What do we learn from the statement that Allah makes a flower with as much artistry as a tree?
questions.answer: Allah gives perfect care and skill to small things just as He does to great things.

questions.question: What would happen if Divine unity were denied, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Even making a flower would become extremely difficult, and creation would lose beauty and value.

questions.question: How does the passage describe living things that appear all around us?
questions.answer: They are precious and well-made even though they come in great numbers and appear quickly.

questions.question: What do fruits, flowers, trees, and animals do after they come into the world and serve their purpose?
questions.answer: They leave after doing their duties and leave seeds behind.

questions.question: What part of creation in this passage is happening where people can observe it?
questions.answer: The making of flowers, trees, animals, springtime life, and other created things happens before our eyes.

questions.question: What is the title of the part discussed in the marked passage?
questions.answer: It is called the First Mystery.

questions.question: What rule is given at the beginning about a thing and its opposite?
questions.answer: A thing’s true nature cannot contain its opposite.

questions.question: How is that rule applied to Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Since Allah’s power is essential and perfect, helplessness cannot touch it.

questions.question: What causes different strengths or amounts in created things, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Their opposites mix in and affect them.

questions.question: Which opposite affects strength in the example about force?
questions.answer: Resistance does.

questions.question: Since Allah’s power has no opposite mixed into it, what follows from that?
questions.answer: It has no weak or strong levels and no drop in ability.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about difficulty and Allah’s creating?
questions.answer: Nothing He creates is difficult for Him.

questions.question: How is spring used to explain Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Spring is described as being as easy for Allah as making a single tree.

questions.question: How is a tree used to explain Allah’s power?
questions.answer: A tree is said to be as easy for Allah as making a flower.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the quality of Allah’s creation, even in small things?
questions.answer: Small things are made with the same beauty and skill as larger things.

questions.question: If there were no Divine unity, how would the making of living things change?
questions.answer: It would become hard, slow, and maybe not happen at all.

questions.question: What two good qualities do the fruits, flowers, trees, and animals have together?
questions.answer: They are very valuable and also made with fine artistry.

questions.question: How do these created things arrive in the world?
questions.answer: They come in an orderly way into existence.

questions.question: After finishing their work, what sign of continuation do they leave?
questions.answer: They leave their seeds behind.

questions.question: In simple words, what does the First Mystery say about Allah’s power and weakness?
questions.answer: Allah’s power never has any weakness in it.

questions.question: Why is joining power and weakness called impossible in the passage?
questions.answer: Because they are opposites and cannot truly exist together in the same perfect way.

questions.question: What example from light helps explain the idea of degrees?
questions.answer: Light seems stronger or weaker when darkness is involved.

questions.question: What example from temperature helps explain the same idea?
questions.answer: Heat changes in level when coldness is mixed with it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about weakness or lack in Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Neither of them can be in it at all.

questions.question: If Allah’s power has no levels, what does that mean about creating big and small things?
questions.answer: Big and small things are equally easy for Him.

questions.question: What cannot stand in the way of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: No obstacle can block it.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the final rising of people and springtime?
questions.answer: Both are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: What comparison is made between a tree and a flower?
questions.answer: A tree is no harder for Allah than a flower.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the beauty of Allah’s work in a flower, a tree, and spring?
questions.answer: Each is made with amazing beauty and wisdom.

questions.question: According to the passage, what wrong result follows if people reject Divine unity?
questions.answer: They would have to imagine creation as difficult and less beautiful.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the speed and ease with which many living things are made?
questions.answer: They are made quickly and easily.

questions.question: Why is it important that these living things are still valuable and artistic even though they are many?
questions.answer: It shows great power and wisdom, not carelessness.

questions.question: What do these living things do that shows they obey Allah?
questions.answer: They praise Him, carry out their jobs, and then go, leaving seeds behind.

questions.question: What first idea does the passage teach before speaking directly about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It teaches that a real quality cannot be joined by its opposite.

questions.question: What opposite of power is named in the passage?
questions.answer: Helplessness or inability.

questions.question: Why can that opposite never touch Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s power belongs perfectly to His own sacred Being.

questions.question: How does the passage explain where levels in things come from?
questions.answer: They come when an opposite enters and affects them.

questions.question: What are the three examples used to explain this?
questions.answer: Light and darkness, heat and cold, and strength and resistance.

questions.question: What conclusion is drawn from these examples about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Allah’s power has no levels and no weakness.

questions.question: Since there is no weakness in Allah’s power, what does that mean about obstacles?
questions.answer: Obstacles cannot prevent Allah from creating.

questions.question: Which four creations are compared to show equal ease for Allah?
questions.answer: Resurrection, spring, a tree, and a flower.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the artistic quality of Allah’s work in these creations?
questions.answer: Each is made with wonderful skill and beauty.

questions.question: What would become difficult without Divine unity according to the passage?
questions.answer: Making a flower, a tree, and spring would all become very hard.

questions.question: What would happen to the beauty and worth of creation without Divine unity?
questions.answer: It would lose its fine value and artistic excellence.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the number of fruits, flowers, trees, and animals?
questions.answer: They are found everywhere and in large amounts.

questions.question: Even though they are many, how are they still described?
questions.answer: They are still precious and carefully made.

questions.question: What is left behind after these beings finish their lives and duties?
questions.answer: Their seeds remain in their place.

questions.question: What does the passage say about opposites and true nature?
questions.answer: An opposite cannot enter the true nature of something essential.

questions.question: How is that rule connected to Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Since His power is essential to Him, its opposite cannot enter it.

questions.question: What is the opposite of power mentioned here?
questions.answer: Weakness or inability.

questions.question: What lesson do the examples of light, heat, and strength teach?
questions.answer: They teach that differences in level come from the presence of an opposite.

questions.question: Why are there no stronger or weaker levels in Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because no opposite can mix with it.

questions.question: If there are no levels in Allah’s power, how does He create things?
questions.answer: He creates all things with the same complete ability.

questions.question: What effect do obstacles have on Allah’s power?
questions.answer: They have no effect and cannot stop it.

questions.question: How does the passage compare making a huge event and making a small thing?
questions.answer: It says both are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: What huge event is mentioned as easy for Allah?
questions.answer: The great resurrection.

questions.question: What seasonal event is mentioned as easy for Allah?
questions.answer: The coming of spring.

questions.question: What everyday natural examples are mentioned as easy for Allah?
questions.answer: A tree and a flower.

questions.question: What does the passage say would happen to production time without Divine unity?
questions.answer: A living thing made quickly now might take a year or might never be made.

questions.question: What does the regular coming of plants and animals into existence show?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s power, order, and wisdom.

questions.question: Besides existing, what three things do these creatures do in the passage?
questions.answer: They glorify Allah, fulfill their tasks, and leave seeds behind.

questions.question: In the First Mystery, what impossible idea is rejected at the start?
questions.answer: The idea that a thing and its opposite could truly join together.

questions.question: Why is that idea rejected?
questions.answer: Because opposites cannot fit into the same essential reality.

questions.question: What does this teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It teaches that no helplessness can be part of it.

questions.question: What makes light appear in higher and lower amounts in the example given?
questions.answer: Darkness mixing with it.

questions.question: What makes heat vary in the example given?
questions.answer: Coldness affecting it.

questions.question: What makes physical strength greater or less in the example given?
questions.answer: Resistance working against it.

questions.question: What important truth is learned from all three examples?
questions.answer: Things have levels when opposites affect them, but Allah’s power has no such weakness.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s creating all things?
questions.answer: He creates everything as easily as if it were one single thing.

questions.question: What can never make Allah’s creating difficult?
questions.answer: No obstacle and no created thing can do that.

questions.question: How are resurrection and spring compared?
questions.answer: They are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: How are a tree and a flower compared?
questions.answer: They are also equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: What is one reason the passage gives for believing in Divine unity?
questions.answer: Without it, even small acts of creation would seem impossibly hard.

questions.question: How are the world’s fruits, flowers, trees, and animals described in relation to number and beauty?
questions.answer: They are many and common, yet still full of value and fine design.

questions.question: What final picture does the passage give of these living things after their work is done?
questions.answer: They leave this world after serving, while their seeds remain for what comes next.
